 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SUNIL DUTTA MISHRA  ORAL ORDER 3 24-03-2026
On repeated call, no one is present on behalf of the petitioners, however, learned A.P.P. for the State is present.
On the previous date (i.e. 21.03.2023) also no one was present on behalf of petitioners.

2. The present petition has been filed for quashing the order dated 09.09.2014 passed by the learned S.D.J.M., Sheikhpura in Case No. 53C of 2014 by which cognizance was taken against the petitioners for the offences under Section 498A/34 of the I.P.C. and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Considering the fact that the matter is of the year Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.54824 of 2015(3) dt.24-03-2026 2015 and petitioners have lost their interest to press the petition, the present petition stands dismissed for non-prosecution.

(Sunil Dutta Mishra, J) rakhi/-
